content: Financial calculations must use Decimal rather than floating-point arithmetic.
context: Team coding standard for monetary calculations

content: PR #42 introduced a floating-point precision issue in billing calculations. The fix was to use the Decimal type for all monetary values.
The team should use the existing money utility for monetary calculations rather than creating duplicate helpers. The utility is located at src/utils/money.py and provides Decimal-based operations.
Service-layer functions should use the project's standard error handling pattern. All service methods must return Result<T, Error> types instead of throwing exceptions.
context: Team coding standard for error handling

content: A billing service bug was caused by floating-point precision. The issue occurred when calculating totals for orders with many items, leading to cent-level discrepancies. Fixed by migrating to Decimal-based calculations.
Reviewers should prefer existing shared utilities before introducing duplicate implementations. Check src/utils/ and shared/ directories for existing helpers before writing new ones.
